name: school_ops
summary: Transport routes, stops and vehicles with learner assignments, a library catalogue and loan desk, boarding houses and dormitories, a two-sided inventory ledger and cafeteria menus with meal subscriptions
description: Implements the campus operations module from the blueprint. TRANSPORT: a school.transport.route (campus, vehicle, origin, destination) with ordered school.transport.stop lines, a school.transport.vehicle (plate, seat capacity, driver reusing school.staff.member, availability status) and school.transport.assignment rows linking a learner to a route and stop; confirming an assignment is guarded by the route vehicle's remaining seats. LIBRARY: a school.library.book catalogue with total/available copy counts and school.library.loan records that are issued only when a copy is free (decrementing availability) and returned by restoring the copy and levying a computed overdue fine. BOARDING: school.boarding.house with a matron (school.staff.member) and school.boarding.dormitory units of bed capacity, and school.boarding.boarder assignments guarded by the dormitory's free beds. INVENTORY: school.inventory.item stock records with a reorder level and low-stock flag, and a school.inventory.movement receipt/issue ledger whose posted movements fold quantity into on-hand stock and refuse an issue that would go negative. CAFETERIA: school.cafeteria.menu offerings and school.cafeteria.subscription meal plans with a pending/active/paused/ended lifecycle. Capacity, bed and stock guards, overdue and fine arithmetic and movement application are server-validated and unit-tested. Navigated under the single School app.
author: Nexa
